reason: settleDocumentDrafts is defined at read-on-add.ts:133. The only reference is a test, and no migration or route performs the same update, so drafts drawn from client documents before this commit stay 'draft'.

A round opens only when one is due, and the lazy open is documented as intended; a side read only opens the round earlier with the same picks. The one real wrinkle is small: the Next round route reads first, so a round already due can return a 409.

currentRound is awaited without a fallback and shell-data.ts calls readBounties uncaught; but readBounties already ran several uncaught queries before this commit, so the round adds one more read/write to an existing failure mode.

readBountyHistory shows clients the note of the latest movement as 'The answer'. Movements include strategist moves through the strategist-only move_enquiry route, whose note is the strategist's reason, so a client can read internal notes.

acceptAttempt overwrites state_reason for every non-superseded insight of the run and branch, replacing earlier reasons with the recorded 'earlier_attempt', so the claim of no record is wrong. An earlier attempt in the same run being client-visible is not a realistic path.

retireIfShown supersedes any original not superseded or merged, including rejected ones; recompute runs wait for release under review mode, and clientInsightSql shows a superseded insight when nothing later is released, so the rejected original becomes client-visible.

runVerificationStage sets 'truncated' only in its CeilingError branch and rethrows; scoring-retry catches it, marks checks 'deferred' and skips presentation. A truncated verification is never treated as complete.
The archive route only sets archived_at and never unschedules; a cron registered earlier keeps firing and the cycle handlers do not check archived_at, at least until a worker restart.

Plan asks are stored with origin 'plan_derivation'; Bounty paths require origin 'conversation'; research spawns any open directed_question with no domain; syncPlanEnquiries deactivates such rows on every config save.

typicalRunMs('derivation') takes the median of complete derivation-scope runs, which include recomputes, batch reruns and edit runs, so the 'time left' mixes unlike work. Impact limited to the estimate text.
readResearchTopics(...).catch(() => null) swallows the error without logging; planStatus then returns 'Did not start' for a failed run. Trigger is a failed topics read, so impact is low.
fetchBrand upserts colour, logo_url and fonts as null whenever the read is not usable, overwriting stored values; a transient failure wipes the brand previously read (overrides survive).

The commit edits the already-shipped migration 123; migrate.ts skips files already recorded, so a database that applied 123 earlier never gets the new columns the brand code uses. The alter also omits the logo_data check constraint.

research_act builds the path from the turn's fixed subject; pageActionFor refuses any path outside the conversation's subject, and the request passes the route's own checks; client turns get no pageAction. No path to a wrong subject was found.
